# Deadline-Radar

> CPA license renewal deadlines by state, each traced to the state board's own page plus the
> codified statute or rule behind it. Free individual reminders; a paid tier for firms tracking
> multiple staff.

## Coverage

- 55 jurisdictions listed (the 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico, Guam, US Virgin Islands, and
  the Northern Mariana Islands).
- 31 have a single fixed renewal date shown directly.
- 6 renew on a birth-month cycle (the exact date depends on your birth
  month, computed automatically once you provide it).
- 18 depend on your specific license type or cohort, or have no
  independently verifiable published date -- the visitor enters their own license's date and we
  track it from there rather than guess or round up.

## How dates are verified

Every published date is checked against two independent sources where both exist: the state board's
own page, and the actual codified statute or administrative rule the requirement derives from -- not
a summary of it, the primary legal text. A small number of jurisdictions publish a date on the board's
own page with no corresponding codified text to confirm it against; those dates are shown but clearly
labeled "Board-page sourced only" rather than presented as independently confirmed. Full method:
https://deadline-radar.com/methodology/

## Datasets tracked, per jurisdiction where applicable

- License renewal cycle and next deadline
- CPE (continuing education) hour requirements
- Reinstatement rules and delinquency fees/penalties for a lapsed license
- Renewal fees
- Interstate practice-privilege (mobility) rules for CPAs and firms
- Pending rule changes we're actively monitoring: https://deadline-radar.com/rule-changes/

## Free tools

- Deadline calculator: https://deadline-radar.com/deadline-calculator/
- Practice Privilege Check (can my firm/staff practice in another state?):
  https://deadline-radar.com/practice-privilege-check/

## What this site does not do

Not legal, tax, or professional advice -- every page carries that disclosure. We do not verify CPE
hour completion (self-reported wherever it appears) or a state's proposed-but-not-yet-effective rule
changes; we wait for a rule to actually take effect before citing it as current.
